
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
install.packages("janitor")
library(janitor)
md_crime<- read_csv("md_crime2023-2024.csv")



```


```{r}
homicide_summary <- md_crime %>%
summarize(
mean_homicide = mean(homicide, na.rm = TRUE),
median_homicide = median(homicide, na.rm = TRUE),
min_homicide = min(homicide, na.rm = TRUE),
max_homicide = max(homicide, na.rm = TRUE)
)




```
